resources.string: Everything is checked on this phone. Message text is read by the on-device model and then dropped: it is never stored or uploaded. We never record call audio or read contacts beyond a yes/no match.
Set as Caller ID & spam app
A guard for calls from unknown numbers
Scammers call pretending to be your bank, the police or a courier, then ask for an OTP, ask you to forward calls, merge a call or install a screen-sharing app.
When an unknown number calls, Scam Call Guard watches what happens on your phone around that call and warns you in real time if it looks like a scam. Everything is checked on this phone.

Phone numbers are stored only as one-way codes (hashes) and shown masked. When a call is flagged as a scam, only the caller\'s number, the risk score and the detected tactics are sent to the cyber-crime authority dashboard. Audio, call text, SMS text and your contacts never leave the phone.

SMS lets us notice that an OTP or debit message arrived. Phone and contacts let us check whether a caller is unknown. Notifications let us warn you. You can deny any of these; protection will be limited and the Health screen explains what is missing.
You can change all of this later in Health & permissions.
On this Android version, open your Phone app settings and choose Scam Call Guard as the Caller ID & spam app if your phone offers it. Otherwise caller numbers are read from the call state.
Samsung: Settings › Apps › Scam Call Guard › Battery › Unrestricted.
Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO: Settings › Apps › Manage apps › Scam Call Guard › Autostart on, Battery saver › No restrictions.
Oppo / Realme / OnePlus: Settings › Battery › App battery management › Scam Call Guard › Allow background activity and Auto launch.
Vivo / iQOO: Settings › Battery › Background power consumption › Allow; i Manager › App manager › Autostart on.
Notice events such as an OTP arriving, a debit, forwarding switched on, and score them on this phone.
Ask to listen to suspicious calls

When a call from an unknown number connects, we ask first. Only if you tap Allow, the phone\'s speech service turns the call into text (put the call on speaker) and we check it for scam phrases. No audio is recorded. The text of what was said is kept on this phone only, with the call in History, so you can see it later; it is never sent anywhere by this app. The speech service may use Google\'s servers.
Allow sharing event scores (never text or audio) to improve detection. Not used in this build.

What the app can and cannot see

Can see (with your permission): call state and whether the caller is unknown, incoming SMS (checked in memory), debits and OTP arrivals, call-forwarding status where your carrier answers *#21#, remote-access apps opened during a call (usage access), video calls in WhatsApp, Skype and similar apps (notification access), text on screen during a video call only when you start a screen check, new app installs, mobile-data loss, numbers you reported.
Cannot see: call audio or what the caller says, messages in WhatsApp or other apps, links\' page content, your bank app, or calls on another phone. Forwarding status is unavailable on many carriers.
Numbers are stored only as one-way codes and shown masked. A report counts as one piece of evidence, not proof.
That does not look like a phone number.
Stored on this phone: call windows (masked numbers, events, scores), suspicious-message verdicts without text, and your feedback. Nothing is uploaded.

The file contains model scores, feature values and your feedback, but no message text, phone numbers or number codes. You choose where it is saved. Share it only if you want to help review the models.
